title: Expedition Complete
text: The code wall is copied and the Choir's tower has a listener. The tenders walk their loop as if we had always been here. If we leave anything standing, they will probably tend it.

choices.label: Return to Touchdown
choices.reply: The convoy turns for home. Behind it the tower keeps pulsing.

choices.label: Stay a while
choices.reply: The expedition stays. The Command Core can take us home whenever we're ready.
